title: A bounded-index list on a segment
statement: A list of natural numbers is located at index $a$ in a function from natural numbers to integers, with length $N$, value bound $p$, and upper limit $top$, if its length is $N$, its entries agree with the function on the consecutive indices starting at $a$ (after viewing each list entry as an integer), every entry is strictly less than $p$, and $a+N\le top$.
hypotheses_covered: At every position in the list, the function value at the corresponding index starting at $a$ equals the list entry viewed as an integer.
Every list entry is strictly less than $p$.
